title: Comcast
desc: I keep about 15 daily business reports and the pipelines that feed them running on time, using SQL, Java and CloverDX over hundreds of thousands to millions of records.
bullets: Cut more than 6 hours from the total daily reporting run by adding parallel processing to four or five report families, with parallel PL/SQL and CloverDX graphs.
Rewrote a slow query, added indexes and changed its joins, cutting that report's runtime by over 80%. Took a separate recurring report from four or five hours down to about one.
Support about 15 recurring reports. Built two of them end to end and drove the design of about five more.
Automated an API import of another team's data into the reporting database, with retries for rate limits and other failures.
Built report-failure alerts over Slack, Teams and email, including an end-of-day alert when a report fails to publish, and moved the Slack alerts to OAuth.
Upgraded CloverDX from 6.3.1 to 7.4.2 and updated the reports and graphs that depend on it.
Build Java data-ingestion pipelines that move data between internal systems.
Write and maintain the Oracle PL/SQL packages, procedures and migration scripts behind an internal fulfillment-accuracy reporting system.
Review teammates' code and mentor new contractors on the team.

title: Turn 14 Distribution
desc: Four years on the company's B2B e-commerce platform and warehouse management system, from the PHP pages down to the MySQL schema.
bullets: Built and maintained database-driven web applications in PHP, MySQL and JavaScript/jQuery for internal teams and outside B2B clients.
Designed and tuned a MySQL schema of 1,000+ tables averaging 700K+ rows each, and set up replication for read scaling.
Wrote queries and reports against high-volume tables for internal teams and B2B clients.
Refactored 10,000+ lines of legacy code across many files so it was easier to maintain and faster to run.
Developed, reviewed and tested code on my own for several production applications, working in an Agile team.

title: Temple University

Helped shape a semester workload that students could learn from at a steady pace.

title: Five Below
